fixed.how: A refusal is a stop like a limit under ask: askFor files the one ask card for it ('Use your API key until a new sign-in is saved?', refusedAskWords in credential-words.ts) with the usual grant, which ends when a different credential is saved (the stop key changes). The refused card stays the notification with its link and no options; its body (views.credentialRefusedFor) reads '... Save a new one in Settings, or go on with your API key until then (about CHF N).' while the ask card is open, '... until then your API key does the work, at a cost per use.' after Use API key, '... until then the work waits.' after Wait or with no card. This puts the options on the ask card rather than on the refused card itself (the acceptance's literal shape); the session lead may prefer it the other way.

new_problems: The fixer's new_problems still stand: the intake card's 'milestone(s)', 'task(s)', 'doc(s)' (intake.ts ~1476); the refused card's withdrawn line 'A new one is saved; ...' also when TR-10 closes it with nothing waiting; credential_policy's narrows treats an unset earlier value as rank 0.
GET /settings/billing-order and the current Settings section still read billing_order (personOrderOf), not credential_policy (C6 replaces the screen).
syncAskAnswers writes the grant, calls onGrant, then marks the card applied, not atomically; a crash between could start a second continuation after a restart.
onGrant readmits every ready task of a project with a running session, not only the ones that waited for the stop.
compose's credentialHold reads human.timezone and monthly_cap_usd_micro captured at compose time, not at each call.
The router falls back to Date.now() when RouteContext.nowMs is absent (current callers pass it).
notes_for_other_areas: session/credential-wait.ts: askCardOpen(store, sourceId, stopKey?) and askShown(store, wait): any sentence that names the ask card (d1109-run-visible's generic 'waiting for Claude, then it goes on' form, d1109-cred-screens' words) passes the wait through askShown, so 'Waits for your answer ... The card is in the Inbox.' shows only while that card is open.

session/credential-words.ts: AskCardWords.done.use/.wait carry no 'Done:' prefix (the Inbox adds it): 'Your API key does the work until 15:40; your session goes on now.'; askCardWords gives refusedAskWords for a refusal stop ('Use your API key until a new sign-in is saved?').

Under subscription_then_ask a refusal of the first choice now files the one credential:ask card (reason 'refused', until null); the refused card never carries options; views.credentialRefusedFor returns rule 'ask' with estimateChf while that card is open, 'next' with other api_key after a grant, else 'wait'.
provider/routed.ts: RoutedProviderDeps.refused(source) (compose: refusedSince over the vault); listModels and maxOutputTokens skip a refused source.

session/task-check.ts: TaskCheckRun not_made gains reason 'held' and an optional wait; runTaskCheck calls the provider's holdNow before its call and noteWait when held (any caller that counts picks sees one extra read-only pick).
session/credential-ask.ts settleAsks gains otherServes(sourceId) (closed_why 'other_cannot'); compose's ask files no card when the month cap has no room.
compose onGrant starts a kept person Start (keptStartOf, with its note) as well as a kept continuation, by 'person', and drops it from the wait.
intake's stored plan wait (summary_cache.intake.wait) now keeps stopKey, ask and stop.

packages/runtime/test/cred-world.ts: a composed world with no injected provider (Messages API stand-in + scripted Claude Code that answers runs, chat and reviews; limitSubscription, limitSubscriptionAfter, refuseSubscription, setKey, setRunReport, keyCalls, key401s, sdkCalls) plus seedProject, startSession, setPolicy and until, for C6's composed tests.

Suggested UPDATE-LOG/CHANGELOG lines (session lead's files): 'Under "Subscription first, then ask me" the app says a card waits for your answer only while that card is in the Inbox.' / 'A refused key or sign-in is asked nothing more until you save a new one, the model list included; under "then ask me" a refused sign-in also gets one card asking whether your API key does the work until then.' / 'After Use API key, a Start you pressed while the subscription rested goes on at once.' / 'The agent's check of its task list waits like every call when your rule holds the subscription; nothing is booked and its notes are kept.'

tests_changed_for_design.why: The reviewer's finding: an injected provider bypasses the routing of reviews and chat; the same cases (one card per stop, restart between filing and answering, Use API key, Wait, the reset) now run on the Messages API stand-in and a scripted Claude Code, plus a second answer that changes nothing. Done outcomes lose their own 'Done:'.
No injected provider (fetchImpl over messagesApiStandIn); work counted from the stand-in's request log; the Done outcome without its own 'Done:'.
The outcome without its own 'Done:' (the Inbox adds it).

tests_changed_for_design.test: packages/runtime/test/task-check.test.ts 'on the subscription stand-in: the call is routed as the intake's planning call ...'
tests_changed_for_design.why: The held-call branch asks holdNow (a read-only pick) before the call: two 'interactive' picks where there was one; the intent (routed as the intake's planning call, booked as a subscription row) is kept.
